confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors rest on five price searches that returned Wellington figures in NZD, mainly from Numbeo and Expatistan plus other aggregators. These are crowd-sourced and disagree with each other, beer most of all. NZD was converted to USD at an approximate NZD/USD level from general knowledge, not a looked-up rate. Cocktail uses a few Wellington data points. Wine by the glass had only a New Zealand-wide range, so it was set from that range and its usual relationship to beer. Accommodation anchors are holistic estimates for a July low-season window from general knowledge; no accommodation prices were searched and no live listings were inspected, so they are the least certain. The FX figure is the latest RBA observation found (18 Nov 2026); a 19 Nov figure was not located.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and drink are based on Wellington-specific price indexes. Accommodation is judged by analogy with other New Zealand and Australian capital-city markets such as Auckland, adjusted for Wellington's government and business-driven midweek hotel demand and a July low season.
